headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Lose $487 Million as Bitcoin Holds Near 83k With Shorts Crowded and Volatility Quiet
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487.07 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost $160.77 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin held near 83k. Fear and greed reads 57, labeled greed, and the cycle index sits flat at 56, so listed-fund cash left even as the mood stayed greedy and the cycle score held its ground. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar is firm at 102.33, and volatility is compressed, with the VIX at 15.41 and seven-day realized volatility at 18.47 against 48.87 over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts and a quiet tape rather than a leverage chase.
author: jordan
